SELECT sesn_seq, session_id, user_seq, login_id, user_nm, status_cd, client_ip, user_agent, TO_CHAR(login_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS login_at, TO_CHAR(last_access_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS last_access_at, TO_CHAR(expires_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS expires_at, TO_CHAR(logout_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS logout_at, CASE WHEN status_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE status_cd END AS view_status_cd FROM adm_login_sesn WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( login_id LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(user_nm, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(client_ip, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND ( status_cd = 'EXPIRED' OR (status_cd = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
AND status_cd = #{status_cd}
ORDER BY login_at DESC, sesn_seq DESC

SELECT hist_seq, user_seq, login_id, user_nm, result_cd, result_msg, session_id, client_ip, user_agent, TO_CHAR(login_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS login_at FROM adm_login_hist WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( login_id LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(user_nm, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(client_ip, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(result_msg, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND result_cd = #{result_cd}
AND login_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{from_dt} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND login_at < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{to_dt} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY login_at DESC, hist_seq DESC
